messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT PAGER: Tokenizer mismatch detected for tenant AcmeCorp in dedicated pool dp-west-1-2. High token counts vs expected -> billing spike risk. Paging @samir.khan oncall.
samir.khan: Seeing it. Alerts started ~10:03 UTC, spike in tokens-per-request by ~3x vs baseline. Root caller: text-infer-01 routing to encoder v1.0.2
jessica.li: Quick context — AcmeCorp is on dedicated with a customer-managed tokenizer. They recently pushed an update last night (v2 of their tokenizer mapping). Could be misconfigured.
rahul.patel: Logs show mismatch between client-claimed token_count and our computed token_count. Example request id: req-9f3a. Client claimed 120 tokens, our compute = 430 tokens.
support-jen: Customer is already messaging Support: complaining about unexpected charges. Sales/account is alerted and asking for ETA.
samir.khan: Reproduced locally by applying AcmeCorp tokenizer mapping on our input stream — it emits different split boundaries. Suspect encoding differences: their mapping treats U+2019 as two tokens.
infra-mike: On dedicated pools we allow customer tokenizer override in /etc/redwood/tokenizers/*.json. Need to check which tokenizer file is mounted in dp-west-1-2 for tenant acme.
samir.khan: Running quick check:

```
$ ssh redwood-dp-west-1-2
# cat /etc/redwood/tokenizers/acme.json | jq .version
"2.0"
# tail -n 200 /var/log/redwood/encoder.log | grep req-9f3a
2026-03-12T10:03:15Z req-9f3a encoder: tokenizer=acme v=2.0 tokens=430
```

So server is using v2.0 while our billing/token-limit pipeline expects normalized counts from v1 (what we validated).
jessica.li: That explains why their token quota was exceeded — our quota enforcement runs post-normalization assuming v1 counts. Need a mitigation path: either normalize counts to v1 for billing/fairness or route customer to a compatibility encoder temporarily.
rahul.patel: Immediate mitigation options:
- A: Patch billing pipeline to accept client_token_count when tenant has a custom tokenizer (fast but risky).
- B: Route Acme to the v1 encoder binary (compat mode) in the dedicated pool (zero billing logic change).
- C: Temporarily set a soft cap and auto-credit overcharges while we fix.
support-jen: Customer preference: They want no unexpected charges and will accept temporary throttling while we investigate.
samir.khan: I'm going to attempt B first. infra-mike can you bind-mount the v1 encoder for acme on dp-west-1-2? If mount fails, fall back to C.
infra-mike: On it. Doing a safe canary: copy /opt/encoders/acme-v1 -> /opt/encoders/runtime-acme && update symlink. Rolling restart worker group wg-enc-4 only. ETA ~12m.

(12:15) infra-mike: Can confirm wg-enc-4 restarted, acme requests now hit encoder v1.0.0. Observability: token-rate returned to baseline for req sampling.

(12:18) oncall-bot: METRIC CHECK: token_rate_acme now within baseline (within 5% of rolling median). No new billing spikes detected.
samir.khan: Good. Next steps:
- Keep acme on v1 for 24h while we sync tokenizer definitions.
- Security/release: get devex to help with migration script for tokenizer mapping compatibility.
- Billing: issue temporary credit for 2026-03-12 10:00-13:00 window and mark charges as disputed until resolved. @support-jen please coordinate account team.
support-jen: Will file support ticket ST-4823 and request credit. Notifying account exec now. Customer asked for a technical postmortem once done.
jessica.li: For long-term: we need to add a compatibility check at deploy time for custom tokenizers in Dedicated/Private; fail-safe that prevents silent token-count drift. Proposal:
- When a tenant uploads a tokenizer, run a delta test suite against our canonical tokenizer for 10k sample inputs. If delta>X%, flag as incompatible and require opt-in.
- Also add per-tenant token-normalization layer that can map their tokens to our canonical metrics for billing only.
rahul.patel: Agree. I'll file an RFC and include perf cost. Also we should surface tokenizer version in the console (Redwood Console -> Models -> Tenant tokenizer).
samir.khan: For the immediate incident: I'll keep monitoring. Leaving this thread open. Handoff to next oncall @rahul.patel at 14:00 UTC. Anyone else wanting to add notes before handoff?
infra-mike: Note: we did not change network or pool isolation; only encoder symlink on wg-enc-4. No restart of worker pools handling other tenants.
support-jen: Customer accepted throttling and will wait for docs. I'll send them a status summary and estimated timeline for the postmortem.
rahul.patel: Taking over monitoring. I'll re-run token-delta job and kick off the RFC. Will update this thread after 1h with status. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: HANDOFF: oncall shift change detected. New oncall rahul.patel. Thread remains incident-1742005012.
